substeps.label: C2 · grind to the target plane
substeps.caption: Then grind the last 0.5 mm down to the target plane: the mid-length of the piece's nine tracks, where the section is taken.

substeps.label: C3 · hot-mount
substeps.caption: Hot-mount face down in conductive compound, so the SEM does not charge. A piece about 22 × 13 mm in section fits a 1.25 in puck: eight pucks per run, two per panel.

substeps.label: C3 · eight pucks
substeps.caption: Eight pucks per run, two per panel, each showing nine tracks cut at mid-length.

substeps.label: C4 · grind and polish
substeps.caption: Grind with 320, then 800 grit; polish with 3 µm diamond, then 0.05 µm alumina (MIT's sequence).

substeps.label: C4 · etch
substeps.caption: Etch right after polishing, because 316 passivates fast: dilute aqua regia for 30–45 s in a fume hood, or 10 % oxalic acid electrolytically. Check the etch and the track order under the optical microscope.

substeps.label: C5 · SEM
substeps.caption: SEM: secondary-electron images of every track at two fixed magnifications, plus EDS spots on a few keyhole tracks to check for Mn and Cr lost to evaporation.
